title: Korea: Gwangju + Jeollanam gyms on hold (second pass)
description: Second pass over six Gwangju and Jeollanam-do gyms deferred on 2026-10-05 (Climb Lounge, Grabit Climbing, Hwasun Rock Climbing Center, Hwang Pyeong-ju Climbing Class, Yeosu Climbing Gym, Mokpo International Sport Climbing Center). Research 2026-10-06.
